description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific published Figma component set using its unique `key`.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving a Figma component set.

key.description: The unique identifier of the component set.
key.title: Key

inputSchema.title: GetComponentSetRequest

name: get_component_set

name.description: The name of the parent component set node, if applicable.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: The unique identifier of the parent component set node, if applicable.
nodeId.title: Node Id

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the frame, if set, in RGBA format.
backgroundColor.title: Background Color

containingComponentSet.description: Details of the component set that this frame is part of, if applicable.
containingComponentSet.title: Containing Component Set

containingStateGroup.description: Deprecated: This field is deprecated. Use `containingComponentSet` instead for information about the component set containing this frame.
containingStateGroup.title: Containing State Group

name.description: The name of the frame node.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: The unique identifier of the frame node within the file.
nodeId.title: Node Id

pageId.description: The unique identifier of the page containing this frame.
pageId.title: Page Id

pageName.description: The name of the page containing this frame.
pageName.title: Page Name

name.description: The name of the state group node, if applicable.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: The unique identifier of the state group node, if applicable.
nodeId.title: Node Id

GetComponentSetResponse.description: Response schema for `GetComponentSet`, providing metadata for a component set.

data.description: The main data payload of the response, containing details of the component set.
data.title: Data

GetComponentSetResponse.title: GetComponentSetResponse

containing_frame.description: Information about the frame that contains the component set, if applicable. This provides context on where the component set is located within a file structure.
containing_frame.title: Containing Frame

created_at.description: The date and time (UTC ISO 8601 format) when the component set was created.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description: The description of the component set as provided by the publisher.
description.title: Description

file_key.description: The unique identifier of the Figma file that contains this component set.
file_key.title: File Key

key.description: The unique identifier for the component set.
key.title: Key

name.description: The name of the component set.
name.title: Name

node_id.description: The unique identifier of the component set node within the Figma file.
node_id.title: Node Id

thumbnail_url.description: URL to a thumbnail image of the component set, if available.
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url

updated_at.description: The date and time (UTC ISO 8601 format) when the component set was last updated.
updated_at.title: Updated At

user.description: Information about the user who published the component set.
user.title: User

error.description: Indicates if an error occurred. For successful requests, this value is always `false`.
error.title: Error

meta.description: Contains the detailed metadata for the requested component set.
meta.title: Meta

status.description: HTTP status code of the response. A value of 200 indicates success.
status.title: Status

handle.description: The name of the user, often their username or display name.
handle.title: Handle

id.description: Unique stable identifier of the user.
id.title: Id

img_url.description: URL of the user's profile image.
img_url.title: Img Url
